mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as falling rates reduce equity discount rates and increase valuation multiples.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return direction is not positive when FEDFUNDS declines over the past 3 months, as measured by a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 returns through market anticipation of aggressive rate hikes.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not negative when CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 3.0%, as evidenced by a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 100 and HOUST rises above 1300, the interaction signals supply-demand mismatch, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through sector rotation.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST > 1300) does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising PAYEMS predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as labor market strength supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE < 4.0, the rising PAYEMS does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO over the past 3 months predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as strengthening industrial output signals robust economic activity and corporate demand.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return direction is not positive when INDPRO rises over the past 3 months, as measured by a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE exceeding 4.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, triggering negative 5-day S&P 500 returns through market anticipation of economic slowdown.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not negative when UNRATE > 4.5%, as evidenced by a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 exceeds 23000 billion and RSAFS exceeds 700000 million, the interaction signals strong economic demand, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through sector rotation.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (GDPC1 > 23000 AND RSAFS > 700000) does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, triggering negative 5-day S&P 500 returns through market reaction to rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.5%, as evidenced by a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
